text:
Anya: Quick sync — follow-ups from the postmortem (2026-03-20). Focus: canary thresholds, auto-rollback, and blast-radius controls. Short list of proposed actions below. Ping owners.

Sam: Thanks. Can we bump canary sample for critical models to 5% short-term? 1% missed the signal during the outage.

Devon: I can take that. Will update canary config and validate in staging. ETA EOD Thu (2026-03-26).

Marta: We should also add an automatic rollback trigger for 5xx spikes > 2x baseline sustained for 2m. Who owns the detector + webhook?

Anya: Sam / Devon?

Sam: I can add the alert in observability (Prometheus) and a dashboard panel. Devon can wire the rollout service to accept a rollback webhook. Agreed?

Devon: Yep. Plan:
1) Prom rule: expr = rate(http_requests_total{job=\"inference\",status=~\"5..\"}[2m]) > 2 * baseline
2) Alert -> webhook -> rollout-service -> trigger rollback on active canaries
I'll open a PR for the rollout-service hook and a small e2e test.

Sam: For baseline calc let's use 30d median per-model per-region (to avoid weekday skew). I'll add that to the alert annotation.

Marta: Also want a hard blast-radius cap: default max 10% for any automatic canary. Anything >10% must be explicitly approved via the deployment flag and an audit entry. Who owns policy enforcement?

Anya: Action items below. Please ack or adjust ETA.

Anya: ACTIONS:
- DEV-101: Increase canary sample for critical models to 5% (owner: Devon) ETA: 2026-03-26
- DEV-102: Prometheus alert for 5xx spike + webhook to automatically trigger rollback (owners: Sam, Devon) ETA: 2026-04-02
- DEV-103: Rollout policy: enforce default blast-radius cap 10%, explicit approval required >10% (owner: Sam) ETA: 2026-04-06
- DEV-104: Emergency feature-flag 'deployment_quarantine' to block all new canaries/deploys (owner: Marta) ETA: 2026-03-30
- DEV-105: Recurring incident pattern tracker + weekly digest (owner: Anya) ETA: 2026-04-09

Devon: Ack DEV-101 and DEV-102. I'll draft the rollout-service PR and include the e2e for rollback.

Sam: Ack DEV-102/103. Need an approver for the >10% exception flow — @Marta? Also want to add a dashboard tile that surfaces canary size vs error rate.

Marta: Ack DEV-104 and approver for exceptions. I'll also update the ops playbook with a short checklist to run before approving >10% (safety review, runbook owner sign-off, QA smoke).

Anya: Example rollback snippet for runbooks (to include in the playbook):
```
# rollback via rollout-service
curl -X POST https://rollout.internal.api/v1/rollouts/ROLLOUT_ID/actions/rollback \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $SERVICE_TOKEN\" \
  -d '{\"reason\":\"5xx spike automated rollback\"}'
```

Sam: I'll add the dashboard panel and an alert runbook note linking to the snippet.

Marta: One more ask — add a 'quarantine timer' so that when the emergency flag is flipped it auto-blocks new canaries for X hours and paginates the oncall team. That way we avoid immediate human error.

Devon: Good call. We can make the timer configurable (default 4h). I'll include that in the PR for the feature-flag endpoint.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: canary-config-2026-03-25 by infra-team — staging run started.

incident-bot: Postmortem linked: /postmortems/2026-03-20-canary-regression (tags: canary, rollback, blast-radius)

Anya: I'll add these tickets to the postmortem follow-up board and schedule a 30-min check-in next Thu (2026-04-01) to review progress. If owners need to change ETAs, reply here. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
